question: How does the lord alone shine as this world by manifesting as causality and other forms?
premises: The lord alone is the agent.
The lord manifests this with his own form.
He shines as causality and other appearances.
inference: All appearances, including causality, are self-manifestations of the one lord.
uncertainties: The range implied by ādi after kāraṇatā is unspecified.
plain_english: You alone, having manifested this with your own form, shine by yourself, appearing as causality and so forth.
